gaps.issue: The actual-to-specification abstraction can be partial, many-to-one or chosen after outcomes.
gaps.counterexample: A finite bit-vector model omits an asynchronous latch or analog metastable mode.
gaps.corrected_now: Total grounding, target identity and fiber coverage are separate simultaneous obligations.
gaps.unresolved_premise: An independently audited realization map for an actual system.

gaps.issue: Model closure can hold while an actual transition is absent from the model.
gaps.counterexample: The specification stays at state 0 while the actual device moves to uncovered state 1.
gaps.corrected_now: Actual forward refinement is explicit and has an exact two-state independence witness.

gaps.issue: An abstract state range can be complete while its actual fibers lack uniform route radii.
gaps.counterexample: Two physical states map to one typed state but only one has a safe same-lineage route to the anchor.
gaps.corrected_now: Universal fiber-to-cell coverage is not merged with abstract inclusion.
gaps.unresolved_premise: Physical fiber bounds and route/channel certificates.

gaps.issue: Encoded digital states may omit peripherals, faults, metastability or deployed-realization differences.
gaps.counterexample: Exhaustive register enumeration misses a DMA-controlled peripheral state.
gaps.corrected_now: Hardware finiteness is specification-only until actual realization/refinement and exclusions are fixed.

gaps.issue: Type soundness can fail to cover actual runtime behavior through FFI, unsafe code, compilation, concurrency or environment inputs.
gaps.counterexample: A well-typed source calls an unchecked foreign function that mutates hidden state.
gaps.corrected_now: Type preservation is only specification closure; runtime refinement and scope are separate.

gaps.issue: A fitted manifold can omit discontinuous contact modes, saturation or rare configurations.
gaps.counterexample: All sampled postures lie on one smooth chart while an untested contact mode opens a hidden branch.
gaps.corrected_now: Universal physical limits, complete hybrid modes and interval/reachability bounds are required.
gaps.unresolved_premise: Validated atlas/mode completeness and model-error bounds.

gaps.issue: A nominal safety envelope may be model-relative and not robustly invariant for actual biological variability.
gaps.counterexample: Unmodeled disturbance exceeds actuator authority and leaves the nominal barrier set.
gaps.corrected_now: Admission population, disturbance set, monitoring, actuation and fail-safe clauses are explicit.
gaps.unresolved_premise: Prospective robust-invariance evidence on the actual admitted population.

gaps.issue: Finite challenge success cannot establish the structural premises of a universal certificate.
gaps.counterexample: Two worlds agree on every tested context and differ at one untested admitted context.
gaps.corrected_now: Challenges refute; positive certification requires a direct or inductive proof route.

gaps.issue: Range closure of a subroute, program or safety envelope does not identify complete organization, C1 truth or familiar mineness.
gaps.counterexample: A typed controller is fully range-certified while the containing human-device organization remains only partially described.
gaps.corrected_now: The application boundary explicitly blocks semantic and basal-experience promotion.
gaps.unresolved_premise: Same-instance complete organization admission and independent B_min interpretation.
